INSERT INTO bookings (booking_id,provider_id,user_id,service_id,date,start_time,end_time,status,address,price,payment_method,payment_status,razorpay_order_id,otp,completion_otp,latitude,longitude,hold_expires_at,search_radius_km)
            VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$17,$8,$9,$10,$18,$11,$12,$13,$14,$15,CASE WHEN $10::varchar=$19 THEN clock_timestamp()+INTERVAL $20 ELSE $21 END,$16) RETURNING *

INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, message, type, data, is_read)
			 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
			 RETURNING id, user_id, title, message, type, data, is_read, created_at

SELECT ps.price,s.name,s.id AS service_id,u.lat AS provider_lat,u.lng AS provider_lng FROM provider_services ps
 JOIN services s ON s.id=ps.service_id JOIN providers p ON p.user_id=ps.provider_id
 JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id
 WHERE ps.provider_id=$1 AND (s.id::text=$2 OR s.slug=$2) AND ps.is_visible=$3 AND p.status=$4
SELECT 1 FROM ONLY "public"."users" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

SELECT start_time,end_time,latitude,longitude,
 (SELECT name FROM services WHERE id=bookings.service_id) AS service_name FROM bookings WHERE provider_id=$1 AND date=$2::date
 AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR booking_id<>$3) AND (status IN ($4,$5,$6) OR (status = $7 AND (payment_method = $8 OR (payment_method = $9 AND hold_expires_at > clock_timestamp())))) ORDER BY start_time,booking_id
SELECT start_time,end_time FROM provider_master_availability WHERE provider_id=$1 AND day_of_week=EXTRACT($3 FROM $2::date)

SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.name,u.photo,u.phone,u.bio,u.location,u.custom_id,u.lat,u.lng,
    s.name AS service,s.slug AS service_slug,s.id AS service_id,ps.price,ps.price_unit,
    p.rating,p.user_id,p.availability,COALESCE(p.is_verified,$5) AS is_verified,p.verification_badge,
    COALESCE(p.kyc_status,$6) AS kyc_status , ST_Distance(u.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$7)::geography, $8)/$9 AS postgis_distance_km
    FROM providers p JOIN users u ON p.user_id=u.id
    JOIN provider_services ps ON ps.provider_id=p.user_id AND ps.is_visible=$10
    JOIN services s ON s.id=ps.service_id WHERE p.status = $11 AND (ST_DWithin(u.geom,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$12)::geography,$3,$13) OR u.geom IS NULL) AND (LOWER(s.slug)=LOWER($4) OR s.id::text=$4)
    ORDER BY u.id,ps.created_at ASC,ps.id ASC

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS,FORMAT JSON) SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.name,u.photo,u.phone,u.bio,u.location,u.custom_id,u.lat,u.lng,
    s.name AS service,s.slug AS service_slug,s.id AS service_id,ps.price,ps.price_unit,
    p.rating,p.user_id,p.availability,COALESCE(p.is_verified,FALSE) AS is_verified,p.verification_badge,
    COALESCE(p.kyc_status,'pending') AS kyc_status , ST_Distance(u.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),4326)::geography, false)/1000 AS postgis_distance_km
    FROM providers p JOIN users u ON p.user_id=u.id
    JOIN provider_services ps ON ps.provider_id=p.user_id AND ps.is_visible=TRUE
    JOIN services s ON s.id=ps.service_id WHERE p.status = 'approved' AND (ST_DWithin(u.geom,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),4326)::geography,$3,false) OR u.geom IS NULL) AND (LOWER(s.slug)=LOWER($4) OR s.id::text=$4)
    ORDER BY u.id,ps.created_at ASC,ps.id ASC
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = $1::uuid AND role = $2

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS,FORMAT JSON) SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.name,u.photo,u.phone,u.bio,u.location,u.custom_id,u.lat,u.lng,
    s.name AS service,s.slug AS service_slug,s.id AS service_id,ps.price,ps.price_unit,
    p.rating,p.user_id,p.availability,COALESCE(p.is_verified,$5) AS is_verified,p.verification_badge,
    COALESCE(p.kyc_status,$6) AS kyc_status , ST_Distance(u.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$7)::geography, $8)/$9 AS postgis_distance_km
    FROM providers p JOIN users u ON p.user_id=u.id
    JOIN provider_services ps ON ps.provider_id=p.user_id AND ps.is_visible=$10
    JOIN services s ON s.id=ps.service_id WHERE p.status = $11 AND (ST_DWithin(u.geom,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$12)::geography,$3,$13) OR u.geom IS NULL) AND (LOWER(s.slug)=LOWER($4) OR s.id::text=$4)
    ORDER BY u.id,ps.created_at ASC,ps.id ASC
SELECT 1 FROM ONLY "public"."services" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x
SELECT is_available,override_slots FROM provider_date_exceptions WHERE provider_id=$1 AND date=$2::date
SELECT ($1::date + $2::time) AT TIME ZONE $3 >= clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL $4 AS valid
